verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework, so it is driven programmatically through its own documented API: agents are configured in code by passing tools to the agent constructor. Registered agents and workflows run on a Mastra server and can ship as standalone endpoints. However, the evidence includes no public HTTP API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the depth of the documented API surface is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/REST API reference or OpenAPI spec for the server endpoints, and independent hands-on evidence of driving Mastra through that API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
